run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference script to perform HER voltage prediction using experimental and computational CSV data
run_ml_inference_with_features: run ml_inference with elemental features added via the add_features flag for enhanced predictions
run_ml_inference_parity_plot: run ml_inference with a cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot comparing predicted vs experimental voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate energies per bulk material from a CSV or parquet computational file for inference
review_ml_inference_cli: review the ml_inference argparse CLI arguments for expt_csv, comp_csv, output_dir, and feature flags
